slides.title: The Problem
slides.subtitle: Sales look healthy. Profit does not.

cards.head: Pain
body: 17.2% of revenue is cancelled or returned

cards.head: Gap today
body: Managers cannot tell real leaks from noise

chart.title: Money leaks (revenue or margin at stake)

slides.title: Our Solution and USP
slides.usp: The only tool that separates real leaks from noise: every alert comes with proof, a confidence level, and a ranked action.

cards.head: What it does
body: Finds each leak in revenue, price, stock and ads
Ranks fixes by money at stake
Explains why each item is flagged

cards.head: Why it is different
body: Tests 10 possible drivers; says 'noise' when it is noise
Refuses to sell a fake risk score
All ML written from scratch, scored on future data

cards.head: Who uses it
body: Downloads repricing list and action plan

slides.title: MVP: What Works Today
slides.subtitle: Built and running on the provided data

steps.head: Data
steps.body: 5 tables joined. 18,000 orders checked. 7 data issues found and documented.

steps.head: Models
steps.body: From-scratch logistic, random forest, gradient boosting, KMeans, robust anomaly alerts, regression forecast.

steps.head: App
steps.body: 8 tabs: Command Center, Investigate, Pricing, Stock, Campaigns, Forecast, ML Lab, Action Plan.

slides.demo: Demo path (60s): Command Center > pricing leak > what-if reprice > Investigate shows 'no real driver' > campaigns > action plan

slides.title: The Biggest Leak: Price Below Cost
slides.subtitle: Not customers. Not channels. The price list.

chart.title: Loss on below-cost completed orders, by category

insights.head: Loss
insights.body: 1.05M lost on completed orders because list price is under unit cost

insights.head: Concentrated
insights.body: The 20 worst products cause 49% of the loss: fix these first

insights.head: Not discounts
insights.body: Discounts add only 22K extra loss; unit_price already includes discount

slides.title: Honest ML: Failed Orders Are Not Predictable Here
slides.subtitle: Time-aware test: train Jan-Sep, test Oct-Dec on unseen orders
slides.takeaway: AUC near 0.50 means a coin flip. No category, region, channel, segment, discount or time group fails more than chance explains (0 of 10 drivers real). We report this instead of a fake risk score. Fix: record cancel/return reasons.

cards.head: Pipeline
body: Join 5 tables; unit_price already net of discount

cards.head: Explainability
body: Stock risk = stock, demand, restock time

slides.title: Action Plan
slides.subtitle: Ranked by money at stake and how sure we are

rows: Reprice the products that are sold below cost
Audit campaign tracking, then cut spend with above-benchmark cost per conversion
Cut cancellations and returns on healthy products, and start recording reasons
Fix inventory flags and reorder the products that will run out

slides.takeaway: Impacts overlap and are upper bounds. Do not add them up.

cards.head: Issues found
body: 76 products have list price below cost
171 impossible campaign rows (clicks > impressions or conversions > clicks)
Stockout flag disagrees with stock level

cards.head: Limits
body: Synthetic data: no real-world causes claimed

cards.head: Impact
body: Marketing: audit tracking, test budget moves

cards.head: Deployment
body: Streamlit app on a public URL
Repo with README and from-scratch ML
Swap in new CSVs to refresh
